_comment: Per-panorama correction for the grounded dome. offset subtracts from the sampled v in the dome shader (v = asin(y)/pi + 0.5 - offset - roll_b*cos(az) - roll_c*sin(az)); absent ids default to 0. Values are either detector pre-fills (see tools/hdri_horizons/predict_horizons.py, conf = inlier fraction) or human-reviewed via tools/hdri_horizons/dashboard.py (conf = 1.0 marks reviewed). Measured by visual review in 3D for old_hall (0.145) and abandoned_construction (0).
